name: MS Teams Meetings
description: MS Teams Meetings audio and video conferencing plugin for Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Please refer to installation instructions [**here**](https://mattermost.com/pl/mattermost-plugin-msteams-meetings) for creating a new Application in the Azure Portal.

settings.help_text: The Microsoft cloud that hosts your Entra ID tenant and Microsoft 365. Choose **Commercial** for the global cloud and for GCC; choose **GCC High** or **DoD** for US Government tenants that sign in at login.microsoftonline.us. Changing this setting disconnects all users.
Copy the **Directory (tenant) ID** value from the App Overview Page in the Azure Portal.
Copy the **Application (client) ID** value from the App Overview Page in the Azure Portal.
Copy the **Client Secret Value** (not the ID) that was created on the App's **Certificates and Secrets** tab.

The AES encryption key used to encrypt stored access tokens. Will be auto-generated if left-blank the first time you configure the plugin. Re-generating the key will clear all previously stored access tokens and all users will be required to re-connect to MS Teams.
